main.description: A Ratioed data visualisation, placed inside a pub.leaflet.content page alongside the standard pub.leaflet.blocks.* types. Renderers that don't know this type skip it, so any block of this type should be followed by a plain text block carrying the same figures in prose.

variant.description: lifelines — every backlink plotted against time, with the threadgate as a hard rule and a log-scaled afterlife. reaction — how long the artist took to close each piece by hand. ledger — engagement before and after the seal, per piece.

alt.description: Plain-language description of what the chart shows, for screen readers.

showLive.description: Query Constellation on render and show how much engagement each piece has accrued since it was measured. The recorded figures stay authoritative; this only adds a delta.
